title: Franklin County Eviction Monitor
text:
Welcome to the Franklin County Eviction Monitor Website. This was a community service project started by Jeff Beihl of Beihl Consulting. There is a lack of comprehensive data around eviction. The Center for Urban and Regional Analysis along with JusticeTech have come together to create tools and datasets to help advocates and policymakers greater insight into eviction trends and issues within Franklin County.
Please contact CURA at cura@osu.edu with any questions about the eviction data, to subscribe, or to unsubscribe from updates.
Below is a blog containing all the information from the original Franklin County Monitor.

How to read this table

Each number shows the total number of eviction‑related events for that quarter and year.
The percentage in parentheses shows how large that quarter’s total is compared with all eviction complaints filed that same year.
Each row represents a year, and each column represents a quarter, with a yearly total shown at the end.
The cells shaded red highlights the highest quarterly total shown anywhere in the table.
The cell shaded green highlights the lowest quarterly total shown anywhere in the table.
Yearly totals are shown in bold for reference and are not highlighted.
Light background shading is used to make it easier to track values across each year. Data source: Franklin County Municipal Court
